claim.purpose: Complete and prove the full recursive ADL Drive context mirror deployment

initial.title: [v0.92][google-workspace][deployment] Complete recursive ADL Drive context mirror
initial.goal: Populate and verify the complete current Drive mirror for docs and .adl/docs/TBD, including the CodeFriend corpus.
initial.required_outcome: The configured Drive mirror reports recursive_live and every generator-selected Markdown file verifies at its repository-relative path with exact bytes.
declared_scope: Configured ADL Google Drive root and seed folder
authority_boundary: The repository is canonical and Drive is a read-oriented mirror
Issue #5802 owns the full recursive deployment acceptance missing from #5587
Drive writes are create-or-update only; deletion and unrelated moves are forbidden
Credential material remains outside the repository and outside retained evidence
initial.task_boundary: Bind approved credentials, run the existing full recursive mirror, repair only observed in-scope defects, independently verify the complete Drive projection, and enable the schedule only after acceptance.
deliverables: Exact inventory and readback acceptance evidence
Bounded code or runbook repair only if live execution exposes a defect
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Current Drive .adl/docs/TBD is recursively populated and listable
AC-2: All 16 CodeFriend files exist exactly once at the expected path and match repository bytes
AC-3: Every generator-selected Markdown file verifies by parent, identity, MIME, listing, and exact content digest
AC-4: The native report is recursive_live with zero skipped or unverified results
AC-5: No remote deletion, unrelated move, duplicate sibling, or credential exposure occurs
AC-6: The automation remains paused on failure and is enabled only after full acceptance
dependencies: PR #5626 recursive implementation is present on current main
An operator-approved Google credential source is available outside the repository
The Google Drive connector can independently list and fetch the bounded mirror
non_goals: Do not import Drive edits into the repository
Do not use AWS or Spot
initial.plan_summary: Prove current failure, bind approved credentials, execute the full native mirror, repair only real in-scope defects, verify the complete projection independently, and publish retained deployment acceptance.

steps.action: Establish the exact repository inventory, installed binary provenance, Drive bindings, and credential source label without exposing secrets
Run the native recursive mirror and repair only observed bounded defects
Independently verify Drive paths and exact bytes, retain acceptance evidence, and decide schedule enablement
Review, publish, shepherd, finish, and clean through typed C-SDLC v2

risks: The approved credential may lack access to the existing bounded root
A large initial tree upload may expose API quota or retry defects
Existing partial paths could contain ambiguous duplicate siblings
The connector may not provide a bulk independent byte-verification primitive
invariants: Repository bytes and installed generator selection are authoritative
No success claim from seeds, index metadata, fixtures, dry runs, or partial recursion
No credential bytes in output, artifacts, logs, commits, or comments
stop_conditions: Credential binding resolves outside the operator-approved source
Any operation would delete or move unrelated remote content
The target root or seed folder identity differs from the declared binding
review_prompts: Does the evidence prove every selected recursive file rather than only seeds or samples?
Are the 16 CodeFriend files exact, unique, and in the current canonical TBD subtree?
Can any reported success occur without exact content readback?
Were credentials and unrelated Drive content protected?
Was schedule activation gated on complete acceptance?
operator_constraints: One bounded subagent review before PR publication
Keep the automation paused until complete acceptance

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove complete authenticated recursive create-or-update and exact post-write verification
Verify canonical folder topology, uniqueness, inventory count, and exact CodeFriend content
Prove local recursive, auth failure, ambiguity, and exact-readback contracts if code changes

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on authentication, scope, listing, ambiguity, upload, readback, digest, or recursion mismatch; retain one actionable failure and keep the schedule paused.
